title: 3 John Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on 3 John 1: the elder writing to Gaius, walking in truth, helping travelling brothers, Diotrephes and Demetrius.

questions.text: To whom does the elder write this letter?
questions.explanation: 3 John 1:1 says the elder writes to Gaius the beloved, whom he loves in truth.

answers.text: Gaius
The chosen lady
Diotrephes
Demetrius

questions.text: What does the writer pray for him in the second verse?
questions.explanation: 3 John 1:2 says he prays that he may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as his soul prospers.

answers.text: That he may travel far and wide
That he may prosper in all things and be healthy
That he may be given authority
That he may write more often

questions.text: What made the writer rejoice greatly?
questions.explanation: 3 John 1:3 says he rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about his truth, since he walks in truth.

answers.text: A gift was sent to the assembly
Diotrephes had changed his ways
Brothers came and testified about his truth
He had seen him face to face

questions.text: What does the writer say is his greatest joy?
questions.explanation: 3 John 1:4 says he has no greater joy than to hear about his children walking in truth.

answers.text: To receive letters from the assembly
To be first among the brothers
To write with ink and pen
To hear about his children walking in truth

questions.text: What does the letter say he will do well to do for the brothers?
questions.explanation: 3 John 1:6 says he will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God.

answers.text: Send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God
Keep them in his own house for a year
Report them to the whole assembly at once
Give them paper and ink for writing

questions.text: What did they take from the Gentiles, according to the letter?
questions.explanation: 3 John 1:7 says that for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

answers.text: Gold and silver
Food for the journey
Nothing
A letter of welcome

questions.text: Who loves to be first among them and does not accept what the writer says?
questions.explanation: 3 John 1:9 says that Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, does not accept what they say.

answers.text: Gaius the beloved
Diotrephes
Demetrius
The elder himself

questions.text: What does the letter say he does to those who would receive the brothers?
questions.explanation: 3 John 1:10 says he forbids them and throws them out of the assembly.

answers.text: He sends them on to the elder himself
He gives them gifts so they stay
He teaches them himself in private
He forbids them and throws them out of the assembly

questions.text: What does the letter say about the one who does evil?
questions.explanation: 3 John 1:11 says that he who does good is of God, and he who does evil has not seen God.

answers.text: He has not seen God
He is of God all the same
He will be first among them
He still receives a reward

questions.text: Who has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself?
questions.explanation: 3 John 1:12 says Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself.

answers.text: The friends who send greetings
The elder himself
Demetrius
The brothers who travelled
